project.name: Legend Lite - Testing (where tests find the repository's files)
project.description: Test support shared by every module: com.legend.testing.Repo, the one answer to "where is this file" under both Maven (working directory = the module) and Bazel (working directory = the runfiles tree). JDK only; test scope everywhere it is used. Exists as a module because Maven cannot otherwise share a class between modules' test trees; under Bazel it is simply //testing.
